versions.name: Camp Billy Gibbons

features.note: A rifle range used only under a certified instructor.
Frontage on Brady Creek, used for swimming and boating.

versions.summary: Texas Trails Council's Scouts BSA resident summer camp on Brady Creek, south of Richland Springs, offering aquatics, scoutcraft, nature, shooting sports, climbing and rappelling, and handicraft.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence). The short list is what the page supports: it is a year-round usage-policy page whose only programme content is its camp-facilities rules, and the council's linked guidebook covers this camp jointly with Camp Tonkawa, so it was not used.
